training_data: Movement Disorders Clinic, Asan Medical Center, Seoul: baseline FDG-PET of 43 PD-MCI (23 PDD converters/20 stable MCI), scans 2011-2015; linear SVM with 10-fold CV
test_data: Independent test set from the same Asan Medical Center (19 PD-MCI: 9 converters/10 stable; scans 2014-2016, retrieved January 2022): AUC 0.73, accuracy 73.7%. Additional cross-sectional sets with no conversion outcome: Asan (18 NL/17 PDNC/19 PDD) and Crescentwood Memory Clinic/Health Sciences Centre, Winnipeg, Canada (22 MCI/17 DLB, plus 10 PD scanned ON/OFF levodopa)
reason: The conversion model's only independent outcome test is a later retrieval of patients from the same Asan Medical Center, so the prognostic model reaches V3 (10-fold CV plus a same-institution test set), not V1. The fixed SVM was also applied to a Winnipeg (Canada) cohort, but only to report what share of cross-sectional MCI and DLB patients it labels as converters; that cohort has no conversion follow-up, so it does not externally validate the reported PD-MCI-to-PDD prediction.

quotes.quote: In this retrospective chart review study, scans from patients with a clinical diagnosis of PD at the Movement Disorders Clinic at the Asan Medical Center in Seoul, from 2011 to 2015, were used to train the SVM classifier (Table 1).
For an independent testing set, additional data were retrieved in January 2022 (the baseline FDG-PET scans were taken between 2014 and 2016).
Table 1. Characteristics of patients in the training data set from the Asan Medical Center

We evaluated the classifier’s performance in an additional testing set of 19 patients, 10 of whom had stable MCI and 9 of whom progressed to PDD. The SVM classifier predicted progression from MCI to PDD with an accuracy of 73.7% and a sensitivity and specificity of 67% and 80%, respectively (Figure 2C).
We used the SVM model to classify patients with MCI versus those with DLB from the Health Sciences Center in Winnipeg. The SVM model classified 94.12% of patients with DLB
as PDD converters, whereas 27.27% of patients with MCI were classified as PDD converters (Figure 3B).
